feed.title: CenterPoint Secures $50M to Improve Houston Grid Resiliency
feed.summary: CenterPoint Energy has secured $50 million from the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) to enhance grid resiliency and reliability in the Houston area. feed.title: Pfizer Targets Cancer-Related Weight Loss With New Ponsegromab Study
feed.summary: Pfizer Inc. (PFE) is initiating a new Phase 1b clinical study for ponsegromab, targeting adults with non-small cell lung cancer experiencing severe weight loss. The study aims to evaluate the drug's impact on muscle mass and physical function in cancer-related wasting, using a quadruple-masked, placebo-controlled design. This move highlights Pfizer's strategic focus on cancer supportive care, a growing area alongside core oncology treatments, with potential implications for PFE's stock sentiment and the broader cachexia and nutrition market.

feed.title: Microsoft retreats from personal AI chatbot race, refocusing Copilot on the workplace
feed.summary: Microsoft is merging its consumer and workplace AI assistant, Copilot, into a single product geared towards corporate customers, effectively withdrawing from the personal AI chatbot market. This strategic shift follows strong competition from OpenAI's ChatGPT, Google's Gemini, and Meta's Muse, with Microsoft focusing on bringing AI automation to office workers. The new unified Copilot will offer enhanced integration with Microsoft 365 applications and incorporate features from the personal version, aiming to boost workplace productivity.

feed.title: A Canadian bank in London is quietly building its rates team with some big hires

The European macro market has seen an exodus of talent to hedge funds in recent years, but there's a possibility of some returning to banking.
